INTRO_1: The doctor said it would be a routine dream sync.
INTRO_2: You know he lied. The one you love is still inside, sinking deeper.
INTRO_3: Layer 1: the office where you both worked late, every night. Find something that belongs to them.
OBJ_FIND_ITEM: Find the item your lover left behind
OBJ_FIND_ITEM_SUB: Something is wrong with this office. Find what belongs to them — and stay out of the Supervisor's sight.
OBJ_INSPECT: Press I to examine the coffee cup
OBJ_WS: The date under the cup... find the matching workstation
OBJ_ESCAPE: The elevator is powered — leave before the dream collapses
HUD_CLUE: [ I ] Clue: a chipped coffee cup
WS_WRONG: The screen fills with static. A shrill buzz rolls across the floor — he will have heard that.
WS_LOCKED_HINT: The screen wakes, then dims: "DATE VERIFICATION REQUIRED". Maybe they left something behind.
ELEVATOR_OPEN: Elevator power restored. Next layer: the park.
ANOM_PRINTER: The printer dies mid-page. Down the corridor, the footsteps change direction.
CALM: The footsteps fade. He has returned to his route.
WARN_STAGE2: The lights are failing. This layer won't hold much longer.
CUE_STAGE2: The walls have... moved. This is not how you remember it.
WARN_STAGE3: A low hum swells up through the floor.
CUE_STAGE3: Space is folding. Some paths have closed. Others — have opened.
WARN_STAGE4: The dream is about to collapse. Get to the elevator!
CUP_DESC: There is a notch in the rim. They always said they'd replace it after the crunch — they never did. The coffee stain no longer washes out.
CUP_CLUE: Pressed under the base: a dried ginkgo leaf, a short thread wound round its stem. A date is written on it in ballpoint: 10 · 17. — The one you picked up together in the park. Someone is still waiting. Whether it is them... the ink doesn't say.
FAIL_CAUGHT_BODY: The faceless supervisor leans down. The neural link ejects you. One line remains on the monitor: SYNC INTERRUPTED. ...Go again. They are still inside.
FAIL_COLLAPSE_BODY: The office folds into a corridor with no end, and then darkness. You wake in the chair, electrodes still at your temple. ...Go again. They are still inside.
WIN_BODY: The doors close behind you. The floor indicator counts down, past every floor that exists. Over the speaker, very softly, a voice that might be theirs — or might be yours: "So you came." — Layer 2: The Park. (End of prototype)
